# Changes in version 0.1.10.9000-2 (2026-09-01)

- Add new file to `.Ruildignore`: `.affiliations.json`

- Update `module_update_zenodoJSON()` to warn if the list of authors in
  the `.zenodo.json` file needs to be updated.

- Update `module_add_HowToCite()` to use the `person()` objects defined
  in the description file when generating the authors list, instead of
  relying on manually parsing a character string. This generates correct
  author names also when the surname contains a space.

- Remove support for the old-style `author` field from
  `module_add_HowToCite()`.
